name: gentle-shell
description: Gentle Shell is a Pi-native workspace for AI-assisted development, bringing parallel coding agents, live tasks, Git diffs, persistent memory, and permission controls into one terminal interface. Powered by Gentle AI and Organic Driven Development (ODD).

analysis.summary_en: One prompt, from idea to reviewed commit: memory, workflow, and evidence in a real session.
highlights: Usage panel: /gentle:usage ( Alt+U ) shows NaN's per-model token quota, not your credit balance, which NaN API keys cannot read.
OGG/FLAC keep the legacy CLI backend (paplay/pw-play/aplay) on Linux and WSL; native codecs are a future phase and Windows OGG/FLAC is unsupported.
Inside WSL the Windows system SoundPlayer is preferred instead: the validated WAV snapshot is mapped to a \\wsl.localhost\ \...
Tasks at a glance: each floor shows its todo progress (2/4 · blocked: …); click it for the full list.
